title: Pillow Too Thick For Me
text:
Pillow Too Thick For Me. I read the product listing where it said this item was three inches thick but it turned out to be much thicker at least four inches, possibly more. This was too much material under my neck. I also tried using it to raise my ankle off the bed and it was a bit better at that task but still a bit too thick. The pillow is reasonably soft. Soft enough that you don't feel the rod inside that helps the pillow hold whatever shape you flex it into. If this were thinner I'd gladly use it every day but it causes too much extension/flex of my neck.
This just didn't work for me.

product_metadata.title: Rampage Memory Foam Flexi Pillow, Citron
features: Can shape it anyway you want
description: Did you ever notice that neck pillows aren't a perfect fit? This RAMPAGE memory foam flexi pillow is a neck pillow with a twist. It can be formed into any size shape so you can use it to fit your neck, or anywhere else that you want most perfectly. The memory foam is extremely soft.
